```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)

# Load data from .csv file
data_file <- if (file.exists("health-insurance.csv")) {
  "health-insurance.csv"
} else {
  csv_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.csv$")

  if (length(csv_files) == 0) {
    stop("No CSV file found in the working directory.")
  }

  csv_files[1]
}

# skip the 4 metadata lines at the top of the MDAT export
raw <- read_csv(data_file, skip = 4,
                col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
names(raw) <- c("group", "age", "count")

# group rows look like "-> MAR -> HICOV -> TEN", age rows sit below them
cells <- raw |>
  mutate(count = parse_number(count)) |>
  fill(group) |>
  filter(!is.na(age), age != "Total") |>
  separate_wider_delim(group, "->", too_few = "align_start",
                       names = c(NA, "mar", "hicov", "ten")) |>
  filter(!is.na(ten)) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(mar, hicov, ten), str_squish),
    age = str_replace(age, "Between (\\d+) and (\\d+)", "\\1-\\2"),
    age_lo = parse_number(age),
    age = fct_reorder(age, age_lo),
    mar = str_remove(mar, " or under 15 years old") |>
      fct_relevel("Never married", "Married", "Separated", "Divorced"),
    coverage = if_else(str_starts(hicov, "No"), "Uninsured", "Insured"),
    ten = case_when(
      str_starts(ten, "N/A") ~ "Group quarters",
      str_detect(ten, "mortgage") ~ "Owned with mortgage",
      str_detect(ten, "Free") ~ "Owned free and clear",
      str_detect(ten, "without payment") ~ "No rent paid",
      .default = ten
    ) |>
      fct_relevel("Owned with mortgage", "Owned free and clear",
                  "Rented", "No rent paid")
  )

# weighted population and share uninsured for any grouping
rates <- function(data, ...) {
  data |>
    group_by(...) |>
    summarise(pop = sum(count),
              uninsured = sum(count[coverage == "Uninsured"]),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(rate = uninsured / pop)
}

# black-and-white friendly encodings (greys + line/shape)
coverage_cols <- c(Insured = "grey80", Uninsured = "black")
# keep lines dark so they do not wash out on a B&W printer
line_cols <- grey.colors(5, start = 0, end = 0.45)
line_types <- c("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "longdash", "dotdash")
point_shapes <- c(16, 17, 15, 3, 4)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig1
#| fig-height: 4
# aggregate first so white borders do not stripe every cell
cells |>
  count(age, coverage, wt = count, name = "pop") |>
  ggplot(aes(age, pop / 1e6, fill = coverage)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = coverage_cols) +
  labs(title = "Population by age and coverage", x = "Age",
       y = "People (millions)", fill = "Coverage",
       caption = "Figure 1") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig2
#| fig-height: 3.6
rates(cells, age) |>
  ggplot(aes(age, rate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(title = "Uninsured rate by age", x = "Age",
       y = "Uninsured", caption = "Figure 2") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig3
#| fig-height: 2.8
rates(cells, mar) |>
  ggplot(aes(rate, fct_reorder(mar, rate))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(),
                     limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(title = "Uninsured rate by marital status (all ages)",
       x = "Uninsured", y = NULL, caption = "Figure 3") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig4
#| fig-height: 4
cells |>
  count(age, mar, wt = count, name = "pop") |>
  ggplot(aes(age, pop, fill = mar)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_fill_grey(start = 0.05, end = 0.9) +
  labs(title = "Marital status by age", x = "Age",
       y = "Share of age group", fill = "Marital status",
       caption = "Figure 4") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig5
#| fig-height: 4.2
rates(cells, age, mar) |>
  ggplot(aes(age, rate, color = mar, linetype = mar,
             shape = mar, group = mar)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = line_cols) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = line_types) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = point_shapes) +
  labs(title = "Uninsured rate by age and marital status",
       x = "Age", y = "Uninsured", color = "Marital status",
       linetype = "Marital status", shape = "Marital status",
       caption = "Figure 5") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig9
#| fig-height: 3.4
# ages 15-64 only, since almost everyone 65+ is insured
cells |>
  filter(age_lo < 65) |>
  rates(mar, ten) |>
  ggplot(aes(mar, ten, fill = rate)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "black",
                      labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(title = "Uninsured rate, ages 15-64", x = "Marital status",
       y = "Tenure", fill = "Uninsured", caption = "Figure 9") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig10
#| fig-height: 4
# one point per table cell (marital x coverage x tenure x age)
cells |>
  ggplot(aes(age, count + 1, color = coverage, shape = coverage)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.25, height = 0,
                                        seed = 1),
             alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = coverage_cols) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Insured = 1, Uninsured = 16)) +
  labs(title = "Estimated people in each table cell", x = "Age",
       y = "People + 1 (log scale)", color = "Coverage",
       shape = "Coverage", caption = "Figure 10") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```
